text.offer: Princess Kateriina says, "My soldiers fight better when they see someone worth following. Stand with them in the next battle and win it. Then raise my flag over a field of the realm."
text.progress: The lieges' battles are called across the realm every few hours. Wear your soldier's shield and join one for the Princess; then claim a flagpole next to land she holds, with her flag from her castle.
text.complete: Princess Kateriina says, "Every flag raised in my name is a promise kept. The people are watching you."

steps.objective: Win a battle for the Princess
Claim a flagpole for the Princess
